Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh (field 6, no A/G/S route named); observed from this dispatch's runtime prompt: Sonnet 5.5, model id claude-sonnet-5-5. No contradiction.

1. DoD results
- WSL capture green.txt: passed for the required pins. T49 (a), T49 (c), T37 (a) GREEN (were RED); T49 (b), T37 (b), T57, T34 still GREEN. 92 tests, 87 pass, 5 fail. Failures: the three accepted 10 s runner timeouts (orchestrating-session-never-limited, orchestrator-sink-bounded, implementor-cap-40) plus two timing cases reported either way: 'a preflight-bound base cap of 20 ...' (runner timeout 10013 ms; it passed in the TR-G-T2 run) and R7-11a (assertion 'the holder released its exact lock inode'; red in the TR-G-T baseline and in this run, green in the TR-G-T2 copy run).
- 'preflight-bound' is not caused by this change: the same case against the UNMODIFIED live guard in the same session times out identically (10016 ms, control-live-timing.txt). R7-11a: red alone (6156 ms) against the post-image copy, green (5936 ms) in the live-guard control, one sample each; the change touches neither the counter lock nor the counter path, but I cannot prove R7-11a unaffected from these samples.
- node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs: passed, exit 0 (9 tests, 9 pass).
- Private-identifier scan: node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/check-private-identifiers.mjs --root . exit 0, output {"ok":true,"findings":[]} (run after the commit, over the working tree including the two committed paths); the pre-commit hook also accepted the commit.
- One commit of exactly the two paths (0dfe853cc01f6ad3478766f922168814fbebadc2), subject as briefed, trailers exactly Dispatch: TR-G-F-20261009 (goldfish) and AI-Assisted: true: passed.

2. Evidence
- evidence/TR-G-F-20261009/green.txt. Command: wsl.exe -e bash -lc 'cd <repo-root-under-/mnt>; node plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/capture-evidence.mjs --out evidence/TR-G-F-20261009/green.txt --label TR-G-F -- node --test --test-reporter=spec scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-F/guard-dispatch-budget.test.mjs'; wrapped exit code 1 (the timeouts above). Comparison baseline: evidence/TR-G-T2-20261009/red.txt (92 tests, 86 pass, 6 fail).
- evidence/TR-G-F-20261009/rerun-timing.txt (two timing cases alone, post-image copy) and control-live-timing.txt (same two cases, unmodified live guard), both via capture-evidence, wrapped exit 1.
- Build: node scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-F/build.mjs, exit 0; post-image sha256 bad0bd5db55cbc362074f640e77d33dc9c2540a3bc915a0fb4c4fe2142b23d79 (84256 bytes), live sha256 61e8fc35463a9103336a7730a547680a7c18ab5779ca19ae14c0091c5e2d9cea (79351 bytes), test post-image sha256 33411458451a7dabd4c067f6b7e94601739ccdd0f7e5fc2e27b6a1325a1b817d unchanged.
- Consumer-safe: node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs, exit 0. Private identifiers: exit 0, no findings.

3. Changed files
- specs/sprint-alfred-epic/signed-package/tranche-2/hooks/guard-dispatch-budget.mjs: post-image of the live guard with 8 anchored edits: producer closing act (isCommitFlowProducerCommand, isClosingAct takes dependencies), pendingBindingMissingBlocked text naming the re-dispatch, exhaustion text lists the producer, comments.
- specs/sprint-alfred-epic/signed-package/tranche-2/TR-G-F-MANIFEST.md: manifest (target, shas, changes, T37 cure and reason, commands, per-pin table, boundaries, not done here).
- Local only, uncommitted: scratch/dispatch-wip/TR-G-F/ (edits.txt, build.mjs, scratch guard and test copies), scratch/commit-msg/TR-G-F.txt, evidence/TR-G-F-20261009/*.txt, this record.

4. Deliberately not changed
- The live hook, the test post-image, the tranche README, other post-images and manifests, every lib/ module, the shared core (dispatch-budget-core), T34/cache.
- Adjacent oddity: the existing git closing-verb pattern tests only the start of the command, so git add ... && <other> is admitted by this guard; left as is.
- guard-lifecycle-ready: it does not mention the producer; whether it admits the producer call was not checked.

5. Deviations from spec
- T37 cure chosen: refusal naming re-dispatch, not per-dispatch binding (binding would contradict the consumption pins at test lines 576 and 1915 and needs a lib/dispatch-budget-binding.mjs change, which is stop condition 3). No change outside guard-dispatch-budget.mjs was needed.
- Scratch guard copy carries a third relocation beyond import anchors: the module-relative plugin root (new URL('..', import.meta.url)) is re-pointed at the live plugin tree so no-injected-root cases resolve agents as the live hook does. Disclosed in the manifest.
- Producer admission is stricter than the git verbs: absolute plugin-root script path equality plus no shell control characters (; & | < > backtick $ ( ) and line breaks) in the arguments. Parentheses in arguments are therefore refused.
- candidateCommit in this record is the parent at commit time (bcbb5e9c3...), later than the briefed 393b8c8a2.
- Two extra evidence runs (rerun and control) beyond the one briefed capture, to separate load from change.
- win32 and macOS paths unverified (WSL only; no full Verify on Windows).

6. Open items
- independent review: pending (class G; only the Elephant dispatches the Opus Critic). PO acceptance: pending. Install of the post-image is the ceremony step.
- Stop condition 2 (a pre-existing green case turns red) was examined for the preflight-bound red and is not triggered: the same case times out identically against the unmodified live guard in the same session (control-live-timing.txt). R7-11a is reported either way as briefed; a quiet-host rerun of both timing cases would settle them.
- Whether guard-lifecycle-ready admits the producer call is a separate question for the owning slice.
- No other stop condition triggered. Tool uses: 48 counted at the commit-show call, about 52 at close (base cap 60); closing allowance unused.
